info.name: ShopEase API
info.description: ShopEase through the API Gateway. Run the folders in order (Collection Runner or Newman). Tokens and IDs are kept in collection variables during the run and cleared at the end; nothing secret is stored in this file. Payments use the development MOCK provider only. Folder 3 needs an admin account (see its description).

item.name: 1. Registration and login
item.description: Creates a fresh customer for this run (random email), logs in, rotates the refresh token.

exec: pm.test("account schema, no password or hash", () => {

item.name: 2. Authenticated user operations
item.description: Profile (created on first access) and delivery addresses of the caller.

item.name: 3. Catalog setup (admin)
item.description: Needs an account with the admin role: set adminEmail/adminPassword and promote it first (`docker compose exec auth_service python -m app.cli promote-admin <email>`).

item.name: 5. Orders
item.description: Two-step checkout: create the order, then pay it. Prices always come from the server.

item.name: 6. Payments (MOCK provider)
item.description: Development mock only: no money moves. Tokens: mock_tok_success, mock_tok_decline, mock_tok_timeout, ...

exec: pm.test("succeeded with a mock reference", () => { pm.expect(p.status).to.eql("SUCCEEDED"); pm.expect(p.provider_reference).to.match(/^mock_/); });

item.name: 7. Errors and unauthorized cases
item.description: Every error uses the ShopEase envelope.
